title: Pulse alerting automation-webhook event
description: Alertmanager-native webhook payload exposed as Pulse's automation-webhook event contract. Every human-readable field has a structured equivalent (REQ-A11Y-02); payloads carry no credentials, secret-reference strings, or raw probe bodies (REQ-SEC-02).

version.description: Alertmanager webhook payload schema version. Pinned to the v0.27.0 native value.

groupKey.description: Stable key of the alert group as grouped by [estate, host, service, alertname] (REQ-ROUTE-02). Identifies the group whose firing-before-resolved order is preserved (REQ-HOOK-03).

receiver.description: Emitting receiver name; for the mirror this is 'pulse-webhook-mirror'.

commonLabels.description: Labels common to every alert in the group (structured equivalent of the group summary).

fingerprint.description: Retry-stable per-identity event ID (REQ-HOOK-04). Reused across redeliveries so consumers dedupe idempotently.

severity.description: Response-oriented severity (REQ-SEV-01). Never 'deadman' on the mirror.

annotations.description: Human-readable text; each has a structured label equivalent above (REQ-A11Y-02).

endsAt.description: RFC 3339 resolve timestamp; the zero time '0001-01-01T00:00:00Z' while firing (REQ-HOOK-02, REQ-SEV-05).

generatorURL.description: Source query URL (vmalert/Gatus). No credential material (REQ-SEC-02).
